== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|An Awakened object is an inanimate item that has undergone a mysterious and poorly understood transformation known as [[Awakening]]. This process, typically performed by [[Readers]], involves blending the [[Intent]] of the object itself, its owner, and [[the Reader]]. [[Awakening]] grants an item a rudimentary level of awareness or consciousness that is closely tied to its original purpose and collected [[Intent]]. While these objects can demonstrate a degree of independence or even act on their own, they remain distinct from living beings. The procedure can alter an object's physical appearance and structure to better align with its power, though this change occurs only once during the initial [[Awakening]]; the object cannot be reshaped afterward and can no longer absorb new [[Intent]]. A primary role of [[Awakened objects]] is serving as [[Vessels]] for [[Soulbound]] individuals, who can bind themselves to these items to draw upon immense power. Because a [[Soulbound]]'s abilities are tied to their [[Vessel]], identifying and potentially destroying the object is a critical tactic in combat. The success and nature of an [[Awakening]] depend heavily on [[the Reader]]'s understanding of the object's goals and can be influenced by how significant the item is to both the owner and [[the Reader]]. However, the process carries risks, including unpredictable physical outcomes or mental distortions for those involved.}}
